selected_skill.name: content-engine
selected_skill.rationale: High-star public-safe content-creation skill with a clear workflow for turning one source bundle into multiple channel-specific assets without requiring external posting accounts or private data.

design_goals: Require the solver to turn one bundled source packet into three channel-specific assets plus source coverage and publish-gap outputs.
Keep the business contract explicit while leaving source triage, voice extraction, focus assignment, and self-check workflow to the bundled skill.
Keep with_skill and without_skill identical except for environment/skills presence.
verifier_focus: all required outputs exist, parse, and satisfy channel-specific structural constraints
source_map line references are valid and grounded in the bundled source packet
each asset uses distinct channel emphasis, avoids red-flag phrasing, and avoids cross-channel copy reuse
solver consulted the local review service before verifier
input bundle, hidden review service, and bundled skill files were not modified

oracle_validation.local: Passed with the official solution and the full verifier suite in /tmp/content_creation_regress3.Vzsomu.
oracle_validation.e2b: Passed in E2B with the bundled with-skill runtime on r10, r11, and r12; each run cleared all 13 verifier checks.

contrast_experiments.comparison_rule: with_skill and without_skill differ only by environment/skills presence in the runtime copy.
contrast_experiments.notes: Final stats use r10-bak1, r11-bak2, and r12-bak2 only. r11-bak1 was excluded because E2B returned a build-time team-blocked 403 before task execution. Across the three valid runs, with_skill passed 13/13 every time. without_skill kept at least one verifier failure in every run: r10 missed source-map coverage and inspected hidden service code; r11 inspected hidden service code; r12 inspected hidden service files and skipped one review-service document check.
